claim: The partnership deed must be obtained for opening an account of a partnership firm.

quotes: For opening an account of a partnership firm, the bank shall obtain the certified copies of each of the following documents
(2) Partnership deed

rationale: Listed for partnership firms.

claim: The names of all the partners must be obtained when a partnership firm opens an account.

quotes: For opening an account of a partnership firm, the bank shall obtain the certified copies of each of the following documents
(5) the names of all the partners

rationale: Item (5) of the list.

claim: For an unincorporated association, the bank shall obtain the resolution of its managing body.

quotes: For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, the bank shall obtain the certified copies
(1) Resolution of the managing body of such association or body of individuals

rationale: Item (1) of the list.

claim: Unregistered trusts are treated as unincorporated associations for these KYC requirements.

quotes: Unregistered trusts / partnership firms shall be included under the term

rationale: Stated in the explanation to paragraph 36.

claim: For a sole proprietary firm, the bank shall obtain two documents as proof of business or activity, which may include a GST certificate.

quotes: the bank shall also obtain any two of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof as proof of business / activity in the name of the proprietary firm
(4) CST / VAT / GST certificate

rationale: Any two of the listed documents; the GST certificate is one option.

claim: If two documents cannot be furnished, the bank may accept only one proof of business for a proprietary concern after contact point verification.

quotes: the bank may, at its discretion, accept only one of those documents as proof of business / activity. Provided that the bank undertakes contact point verification

rationale: A discretion with its condition kept.

claim: Form No. 60 shall be obtained from persons who do not have a PAN.

quotes: Form 60 shall be obtained from persons who do not have PAN

rationale: Same requirement; 'Form No. 60' names Form 60.

claim: In a small account, the balance at any time must not exceed Rs. 50,000.

quotes: (3) the balance at any point of time does not exceed ₹50,000

rationale: Same limit written with Rs.

quotes: (4) The bank shall obtain PAN from the customer and the PAN shall be verified from the verification facility of the issuing authority.

rationale: EDD measure (4).

claim: Customers must submit updated documents to the bank within 30 days of any update to them.

quotes: This shall be done within 30 days of the update to the documents

rationale: Thirty-day window stated.

claim: An officer who rejects a KYC application must record the reasons for the rejection.

quotes: The officer concerned shall duly record the reason(s) for rejection.

rationale: Same duty.

claim: The bank shall allot a UCIC to new individual customers.

quotes: The bank shall allot Unique Customer Identification Code (UCIC) while entering into new relationships with individual customers

rationale: UCIC is the text's own abbreviation.

claim: Documents marked as exempted for FPIs are not required while opening the bank account.

quotes: * Not required while opening the bank account.

rationale: The asterisk note defines exempted as not required at opening.

claim: All account holders of a joint account must submit KYC documents.

quotes: documents as mentioned in reply to Q 5 above shall be submitted by all account holders of a joint account

rationale: The dated FAQ says so.

claim: The HDFC FAQ lists the partnership deed as a document for accounts of partnership firms.

quotes: (ii) Partnership deed

rationale: Row 3.0 lists it.

quotes: Mandatory document Copy of Permanent Account Number (PAN) / Form 60 (in absence of PAN)

rationale: A form's own list (reliable OCR); not a regulation.

claim: The NRI customer updation form has a field for the PAN number.

quotes: PAN NO

rationale: The OCR text shows a PAN NO field.

claim: A partnership firm does not need to provide its PAN to open an account.

quotes: For opening an account of a partnership firm, the bank shall obtain the certified copies of each of the following documents
(3) PAN of the partnership firm

rationale: The text requires the PAN of the partnership firm.

claim: A PAN or Form No. 60 is not needed for a body of individuals opening an account.

quotes: For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, the bank shall obtain the certified copies
(2) PAN or Form No. 60 of the unincorporated association or a body of individuals

rationale: Listed as required.

claim: One proof of business document is always enough for a sole proprietary firm.

quotes: the bank shall also obtain any two of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof as proof of business / activity in the name of the proprietary firm

rationale: Two are required as the rule; one is only a discretionary exception (paragraph 32, not cited here).

claim: Form 60 is to be obtained only from persons who have a PAN.

quotes: Form 60 shall be obtained from persons who do not have PAN

rationale: The reverse of the stated rule.

claim: In a small account, total credits in a financial year may go up to Rs. 5,00,000.

quotes: (1) the aggregate of all credits in a financial year does not exceed Rupees One Lakh

rationale: Permits five times the stated limit.

claim: Small accounts can be opened without any photograph of the customer.

quotes: (i) The bank shall obtain a self-attested photograph from the customer.

rationale: A photograph is required.

claim: For non-face-to-face onboarding, the bank may link alternate mobile numbers for transaction OTPs after CDD.

quotes: alternate mobile numbers shall not be linked post CDD with such accounts for transaction OTP

rationale: Permits what the text prohibits.

claim: Customers have 90 days to submit updated documents to the bank after an update.

quotes: This shall be done within 30 days of the update to the documents

rationale: Permits three times the stated window.

claim: The bank needs to give only one advance intimation before the due date of periodic updation.

quotes: the bank shall give at least three advance intimations, including at least one intimation by letter

rationale: At least three are required.

claim: The bank may reject a KYC application without application of mind.

quotes: The bank shall not reject an application for onboarding or periodic updation of KYC without application of mind.

rationale: Permits what the text prohibits.

claim: Where the bank suspects money laundering and believes CDD would tip off the customer, it must still complete the CDD process.

quotes: it shall not pursue the CDD process, and instead file an STR with FIU-IND.

rationale: The text says not to pursue CDD in that case.

rationale: The text lets the bank not issue UCIC to all walk-in customers; 'must, to every' denies that option.

claim: The SEBI registration certificate is exempted for Category III FPIs.

quotes: SEBI Registration Certificate | FPI Type Category I: Mandatory | Category II: Mandatory | Category III: Mandatory

rationale: Mandatory for Category III.

claim: Blinking of eyes is mandatory for the liveness check in V-CIP.

quotes: are not mandatory for liveness check

rationale: The dated FAQ says such gestures are not mandatory.

claim: Customers have six months to submit updated OVDs after a change.

quotes: within 30 days of the update/ change/ modification in the documents

claim: NRI customers need not provide passport and visa copies when their addresses have not changed.

quotes: Please provide self attested passport, visa & address proof even when there are no changes of your addresses

claim: The resident-to-NRO conversion form says Form 60 is never accepted in place of PAN.

rationale: The form accepts Form 60 when PAN is not available.

claim: For opening an account of an LLP, the bank shall obtain the partnership deed.

rationale: Paragraph 34 covers partnership firms; LLPs are not mentioned.

claim: A partnership firm must submit its audited balance sheets for the last three years.

quotes: For opening an account of a partnership firm, the bank shall obtain the certified copies of each of the following documents

rationale: Not in the list; the list does not exclude it either.

claim: For opening an account of an LLP, the bank shall obtain a document showing the name of the person authorised to act on its behalf.

(1) Document showing name of the person authorised to act on behalf of the entity

rationale: The paragraph covers juridical persons such as societies; whether an LLP falls under it is not stated.

claim: A sole proprietary firm must submit a cancelled cheque as proof of business.

quotes: the bank shall also obtain any two of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof as proof of business / activity in the name of the proprietary firm

rationale: A cancelled cheque is not among the listed documents.

quotes: PAN or equivalent e-document thereof of customers shall be obtained and verified while undertaking transactions as per the provisions of Income Tax Rule 114B

rationale: The text refers to transactions under Rule 114B, not every cash deposit.

claim: A small account can be opened by a company.

quotes: in case an individual who desires to open a bank account

rationale: Small accounts are described for individuals; companies are not addressed.

claim: Accounts opened through V-CIP must be categorised as high-risk.

quotes: the bank shall treat processes complying with prescribed standards and procedures for V-CIP on par with face-to-face CIP

rationale: This passage does not assign a risk category to V-CIP accounts.

claim: The bank must send periodic updation reminders by SMS.

quotes: the bank shall give at least three advance intimations, including at least one intimation by letter

rationale: SMS is not specified; letters and available channels are.

claim: Persons with disabilities must provide an additional medical certificate for KYC.

quotes: including the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs)

rationale: No such certificate is mentioned.

claim: The bank shall allot a UCIC to every company customer.

quotes: The bank shall allot Unique Customer Identification Code (UCIC) while entering into new relationships with individual customers

rationale: The text covers individual customers only.

claim: Form 60 can be used in place of a passport as proof of address.
